title: Whetstone repository identity
description: Stable cross-repo identity, computed once then PERSISTED and read thereafter (a later remote rename cannot change it). A remote-origin identity MUST carry its identity_basis. The generation algorithm is normative in the Implementation Spec section 6; it is NOT a schema keyword.
$comment: Algorithm (normative in spec section 6): remote -> id='r_'+sha256(canonical_remote+'\n'+join(sorted_root_commits)); no remote -> 'r_'+uuid4hex. Persist in <git-common-dir>/whetstone_repo_id; read persisted value thereafter. Worktrees share via git rev-parse --git-common-dir. local_path and current_normalized_remote are metadata only.
